readme_description: The purpose of this task is classifying clauses in Terms of Service agreements. Clauses have been annotated by into nine categories: `['Arbitration', 'Unilateral change', 'Content removal', 'Jurisdiction', 'Choice of law', 'Limitation of liability', 'Unilateral termination', 'Contract by using', 'Other']`. The first eight categories correspond to clauses that would potentially be deemed *potentially unfair*. The last category (`Other`) corresponds to clauses in agreements which don't fit into these categories. A description of the precise annotation guidelines can be found in the original paper.
base_prompt_preamble:
Classify each clause by type.
Options: Arbitration, Unilateral change, Content removal, Jurisdiction, Choice of law, Limitation of liability, Unilateral termination, Contract by using, Other
